notes: Each of the four for's is given to the object marker standing on the side phrase it introduces (rule 16's demoted-object family); the competing reading gives them to the side nouns as rule 33 supplied prepositions, but a marker is present in every case and rule 33 requires that none be.
The bet ha-ammah phrases are rendered by a bare cubits, so preposition and article alike are unrepresented; the governed noun is rendered, so rule 40 governs rather than rule 30's fusion.
The directive he of qedmah is unrepresented because 'east side' carries no direction, unlike the fused outward of v.4.
